strings.prompt.consent.need: Both partners must agree to overseas AI processing before decorating
strings.prompt.unsupported.title: I can't make that
strings.prompt.unsupported.body: Rooms can only hold licensed items and short text. Try asking to move an item or change a phrase.
strings.prompt.brand.refuse: Specific characters and brands can't go in the room. Want me to make an item with a similar mood instead?
strings.prompt.fail.body: Try again in a moment. The room hasn't changed.
strings.prompt.idle.me.title: Decorating was released automatically
strings.prompt.idle.me.body: There was no input for 3 minutes. What you were typing is still here.
strings.prompt.takeover.title: {name} seems to be away
strings.prompt.takeover.body: There's been no activity for over 3 minutes, so you can take over. The conversation and preview so far stay visible.
strings.prompt.history.empty: No conversation yet. Describe the mood you want.
strings.gen.refuse.title: We can't make that decoration
strings.gen.refuse.ip: We can't make art that copies existing characters, brands, logos or someone else's work, because it could cause copyright problems. Try describing shapes and colors instead, like "a wall piece with soft yellow stars."
strings.gen.refuse.people: We can't make pictures of real people or celebrities. Try a scene or pattern instead, like "a window view with the moon between clouds."
strings.gen.refuse.unsafe: We can't make anything sexual, violent, hateful or harmful. Try describing something cozy instead.
strings.gen.refuse.personal: We can't make pictures with phone numbers, addresses, links, QR codes or lots of text. You can add short text to the room separately.
strings.gen.refuse.photo: We can't make realistic, photo-like images. Describe something soft and hand-drawn, like Aroomi's world.
strings.gen.refuse.purpose: We can only make backgrounds, speech-bubble frames and small room props. We can't make characters, and Aroomi can't be changed. Try something like "a wavy band along the wall" or "a round cushion."
strings.gen.refuse.note: This request didn't count toward today's limit.
strings.gen.fail.title: We couldn't make it this time
strings.gen.fail.body: Please try again in a moment. The room is unchanged, and this didn't use up today's limit.
strings.gen.disabled.title: New decorations are taking a break
strings.gen.disabled.body: You can still use the decorations you made and the other ways to decorate. Please check back later.
strings.gen.lib.title: Our decorations
strings.gen.lib.empty: No decorations yet. Try asking, like "make me a wall decoration."
strings.gen.lib.delete.title: Delete this decoration?
strings.gen.lib.delete.body: It will be gone from your collection and can't be brought back.
strings.gen.lib.delete.inuse: It's in the room right now. Deleting it removes it from the room too.
strings.gen.lib.full: Your collection is full. Please delete decorations you don't use.
strings.chat.start.help: Once you send, you're in charge of the room. Your partner can only watch the conversation and preview.
